drivingQuestion: Are the signs of a kosher bird really absent from the Torah, given a baraita that derives them from the list of forbidden birds?
outcomeNote: The unit breaks off inside the baraita that raises the objection; no answer falls within this sugya.

segments.he: סִימָנֵי הָעוֹף לֹא נֶאֶמְרוּ, וְלָא? וְהָתַנְיָא: ״נֶשֶׁר״,
segments.en: § The mishna states: «The signs of the» kosher «bird were not» explicitly «stated» in the Torah. The Gemara asks: «And» is it true that they were «not» stated in the Torah? «But isn’t it taught» in a baraita: «“The nesher”» (Leviticus 11:13) is a non-kosher bird.
